memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: What every agent of the workspace reads when its Jobs start.

overridden.text: It is {{plugin}}'s. An update of the plugin replaces what you haven't changed, and it goes when the plugin is uninstalled.

people.title: People
people.unavailable: People is unavailable in this workspace.

invitations.createFailed: Could not create an invitation. Try again.

dataRetention.text: For the whole organization: how long deleted people and Audit records are kept before they are removed for good.
dataRetention.personBefore: Permanently delete users and their data
dataRetention.range: A whole number of days from {{min}} to {{max}}

deletedPeople.title: Deleted people
deletedPeople.text: People you deleted from the organization. Each is deleted for good on the date shown; until then you can restore them, with no workspace role.
